question: Using data from ChEMBL Release 23, retrieve all distinct molecules associated with the company 'SanofiAventis,' listing the trade name and the most recent approval date for each molecule. Make sure to keep only the latest approval date per molecule and ensure the company field precisely matches 'SanofiAventis' without relying on other fields.
sql:
WITH sanofi_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ms.molregno
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.molecule_synonyms_23` ms
    WHERE ms.res_stem_id IN (
        SELECT res_stem_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.research_companies_23` WHERE company = 'SanofiAventis'
    )
),
trade_names AS (
    SELECT ms.molregno, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ms.synonyms, ', ' ORDER BY ms.synonyms) as trade_name
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.molecule_synonyms_23` ms
    WHERE ms.molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM sanofi_molecules)
    AND ms.syn_type = 'TRADE_NAME'
    GROUP BY ms.molregno
),
molecule_info AS (
    SELECT md.molregno, MAX(md.first_approval) as approval_date
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.molecule_dictionary_23` md
    WHERE md.molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM sanofi_molecules)
    GROUP BY md.molregno
)
SELECT tn.trade_name, mi.approval_date as approval_date
FROM trade_names tn
JOIN molecule_info mi ON tn.molregno = mi.molregno
ORDER BY tn.trade_name
